action: Expedia customers: no confirmed action yet. Be cautious with emails or texts about bookings or refunds, use a unique password with two-step login on your account, and watch for an official Expedia statement.
exec: A very large but unverified data theft claim against a major travel platform, said to involve a third-party provider.
plain: A criminal group claims to hold nearly one billion Expedia traveller records taken through an outside supplier. This is the group's claim only; no confirmation from Expedia was found.
summary: A Russian-speaking extortion group calling itself n0n claims to hold nearly one billion Expedia traveler records taken through a compromised third-party provider. This is an attacker claim; Expedia's confirmation was not found in the coverage read.
title: Extortion group claims theft of nearly one billion Expedia traveler records

validation.note: Attacker claim reported by one outlet.
